collection.description: A teenager missing on a coastal outing returns exhausted after two nights.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: A teenager who vanished on a coastal outing returns exhausted after two nights, having sheltered from a storm.

text_only.reason: the teen has returned: nobody vanishes now
